title: Found This

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: How them air waves treatin' yah?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How them air waves treatin' yah?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Ah, the dealer's an old friend of mine. Helping me track down some rare prints for the ol' collection. Cuz that's my se-le-ction.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, the dealer's an old friend of mine. Helping me track down some rare prints for the ol' collection. Cuz that's my se-le-ction.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: My fellow traveler, I'm into anything that gives the vibes. And I sense a bit of them on you. Our one and only AG was a multi-faceted wiz of the creative world. Once you're enmeshed, swimming in the salted sea of bliss, you'll notice his presence throughout.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My fellow traveler, I'm into anything that gives the vibes. And I sense a bit of them on you. Our one and only AG was a multi-faceted wiz of the creative world. Once you're enmeshed, swimming in the salted sea of bliss, you'll notice his presence throughout.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Ah, well that's great! What did you happen to stumble upon?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, well that's great! What did you happen to stumble upon?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Heard the music did yah? Those ears of yours must be buzzin' like the bees in the belly of the beast. You got it with you? Let me check it out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Heard the music did yah? Those ears of yours must be buzzin' like the bees in the belly of the beast. You got it with you? Let me check it out.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Well... let's see what vibes Mr. AG left for you to hear. Now this is interesting. I've seen these before, notes like this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... let's see what vibes Mr. AG left for you to hear. Now this is interesting. I've seen these before, notes like this.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: D-sharp, D-sharp, E-flat. They're part of a melody or something. Let me think for a--I know where I've seen them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: D-sharp, D-sharp, E-flat. They're part of a melody or something. Let me think for a--I know where I've seen them.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: A painting: The Ballad of the Nameless PI. They were so faint, drawn on the bottom corner. I can see it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A painting: The Ballad of the Nameless PI. They were so faint, drawn on the bottom corner. I can see it.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: My friend, that was ages ago. Back when I was basking in the glow--Reena. Reena would know where the painting is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My friend, that was ages ago. Back when I was basking in the glow--Reena. Reena would know where the painting is.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Like a needle on vinyl. If that were still a thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like a needle on vinyl. If that were still a thing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you doing up here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you doing up here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What are you doing up here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What are you doing up here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good. Found something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good. Found something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're into art?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're into art?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I found something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I found something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A jukebox.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A jukebox.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Belly of something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Belly of something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What can you tell me about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What can you tell me about it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What can you tell me about it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What can you tell me about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's it say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's it say?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where is it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where is it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm on it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm on it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You really think it's the same thing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You really think it's the same thing?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You really think it's the same thing?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You really think it's the same thing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: To me all notes look alike!
